title: A Young Robotics Engineer Returns
premise: A young robotics engineer returns to her coastal hometown and teams up with her estranged brother to stop an experimental storm-harvesting tower from tearing the harbor apart.

scenes.heading: EXT. COASTAL HARBOR - SUNSET
scenes.summary: Mira returns home and confronts the emotional weight of the harbor she left behind.
action: Mira steps off a weather-beaten ferry carrying a compact robotics case.
Fishing boats sway under a sky flashing with distant energy from the storm-harvesting tower.
A reminder from memory lingers: No prior memory context available.

dialogue.text: I told myself I came back for the town, not for the ghosts in it.
Then stop staring at the tower and help me keep this harbor standing.

visual_cues: Orange sunset reflecting on metallic water.
Electrical arcs pulse around the distant tower.
Wind catches loose harbor tarps and cables.
